name: ui-design
description: Mandatory for any product's screens, a builder's too, and any mock, prototype or artifact that shows them: its design system, colour, type, components; judging the look.

findings.excerpt: **A builder that isn't Claude Code has the pack installed in it too.** Codex reads the same marketplace (`codex plugin add app-stack@product-engineering`), and
- **Install `app-stack` in every agent that builds screens.** Use Claude Code for the user, or with `--scope project` so every checkout of the product asks for
- **Its hooks.** `npx impeccable install` adds edit and stop hooks to `.claude/settings.local.json`, `.codex/hooks.json` and other harnesses' files. Its README
